title: With security filtering in both directions, a role's filter on the many side reaches the one side

source.quote: Filters on either end of the relationship will automatically filter the other table.
source.supports: BothDirections security filtering carries the filter from Sales to Customer

source.quote: You can manually enable bi-directional cross-filtering with row-level security by selecting the relationship and checking the Apply security filter in both directions checkbox.
source.supports: the setting that makes a security filter cross a relationship both ways

derivation: BigSales keeps sales 1 (Ann, 100) and 3 (Cy, 50). With the security filter crossing Sales -> Customer both ways, Customer keeps the customers those sales refer to: Ann and Cy.
